# Afnan Javed

Official website: https://afnanjaved.com/
Business inquiries: hello@afnanjaved.com

## About Afnan Javed

Afnan Javed is an independent software founder and systems builder based in Pakistan. He creates and operates software products and works on practical digital solutions for organizations and business operations. His work brings together custom software, process automation, and AI integration to make complex workflows easier to manage.

Afnan Javed is the founder and creator of Dinaaro and EduPulse, two operational software platforms serving retail businesses and educational institutions. His work covers product strategy, business workflows, software systems and practical AI solutions. He uses modern development tools and AI agents in his workflow, while taking responsibility for requirements, decisions, validation and the delivered systems.

## Software platforms

### Dinaaro
Website: https://dinaaro.com/
Founder: Afnan Javed
Field: Retail management software

Dinaaro connects sales, inventory, customer credit, supplier accounts, and daily business operations. It is developed around practical retail needs in Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

Milestones:
- PKR 1M+ in transaction value
- 2 retail shops
- More than 1 year of operations across Pakistan and Saudi Arabia

### EduPulse
Website: https://edupulse.com/
Founder: Afnan Javed
Field: School management software

EduPulse brings student records, attendance, fees, assignments, school communication, and personalized AI learning assistance together in one platform.

Milestones:
- 900+ students managed
- 2 schools
- Presence in 2 of 4 regions in Pakistan within the platform's operating coverage

## Client projects

### Switch Power Co.
A website project for an electrical and lighting business in Saudi Arabia, designed to make the business and its products easier to explore online.
Website: https://switchpowersa.com/

### Nexus Tech
A Pakistan based online storefront for digital products and subscriptions, including a custom subscription tracking system and renewal reminders.

## Areas of work

Afnan collaborates on custom software solutions, management applications, business process automation, practical AI integration, and digital systems that organize operational information and tasks. His experience includes developing and operating products for retail businesses and educational institutions.

The portfolio is also a point of contact for discussing relevant software ideas, technical collaborations, and digital projects. Project suitability and scope can be discussed directly.
